title: Reflex: GGUF-native cold-start classifier, chat, embeddings and optional RAG (13 models)
description: Zero-shot classification, intent routing, OpenAI-compatible chat and text embeddings on scale-to-zero GPU endpoints, backed by Reflex: a GGUF-native engine that compiles its CUDA kernels ahead of time (no runtime JIT), so a cold worker reaches its first result fast. POST /v1/classify scores every label as a continuation of the prompt in one prefill and returns each label's probability within the set plus the entropy -- nothing is generated, so a decision is one forward pass, not a decode loop. Chat completions stream or not. POST /v1/embeddings (OpenAI shape, plus query/passage input_type) serves Nemotron-3.5-Embed-1B. Optional RAG (off by default): turn it on and chat jobs with a "rag" field are answered from the documents sent with the job, a folder on your network volume or a corpus URL, with the passages used returned alongside the answer. Pick the model when you deploy: Qwen3 0.6B (default, baked into the image), 1.7B, 4B or 8B; Qwen2.5 1.5B or 7B Instruct; TinyLlama 1.1B Chat; Mistral 7B Instruct; Qwen3.5 0.8B; Granite 4.0-H 350M or 1B; Gemma 4 12B (24 GB GPU); Nemotron-3.5-Embed-1B (embeddings only). Any model but the default is downloaded when a worker starts (attach a network volume to keep it across workers), or give your own GGUF URL. On Runpod, cold Reflex was ~42-44s vs the official vLLM worker's ~150s (same GPU tier/day; vLLM also pulled bf16 weights; endpoint types differed) -- most of both is platform provisioning; Reflex's own engine load was ~1.6s. batch_size is always 1 -- steady high-QPS chat wants vLLM. Guide: https://github.com/lateos-ai/reflex/blob/master/.runpod/README.md

input.name: Model
input.description: The GGUF to serve. Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 is baked into the image (fastest cold start). Any other choice is downloaded from Hugging Face when a worker starts (size in its label): once per worker, or once in all with a network volume attached. Gemma 4 12B needs a 24 GB GPU, not the 16 GB pool. Nemotron-3.5-Embed serves embedding jobs only (input with an "input" field); chat and classify jobs on it return an error.

options.label: Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 (baked in, default; best for classification)
Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_K_M, hybrid Gated DeltaNet (0.5 GB download)
Granite 4.0-H 350M Q8_0, Mamba-2 hybrid (0.4 GB download)
Granite 4.0-H 1B Q8_0, Mamba-2 hybrid (1.6 GB download)
Gemma 4 12B-it Q8_0 (12.7 GB download, 24 GB GPU)
Nemotron-3.5-Embed-1B Q8_0, text embeddings only (1.2 GB download)

input.name: Custom GGUF URL
input.description: Overrides Model: a direct URL to any GGUF of an architecture Reflex supports, e.g. https://huggingface.co/<owner>/<repo>/resolve/main/<file>.gguf. It must fit the GPU and the container disk. Supported architectures and their limits: https://github.com/lateos-ai/reflex#supported-models-and-limits

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Only for a gated or private Hugging Face repo in Custom GGUF URL. Sent only to huggingface.co.

input.name: Adapter Arguments
input.description: Extra reflex-openai-adapter flags, space-separated, e.g. "--max-tokens-cap 1024 --default-max-tokens 128". Request limits default to max_tokens 2048, prompt 256 KiB, queue depth 16, timeout 300 s.

input.name: RAG (retrieval)
input.description: on: answer chat jobs that carry "rag" from your documents. The worker also runs an embedding model (Nemotron-3.5-Embed-1B, a 1.2 GB download and about 2.4 GB more VRAM), searches the job's own "rag.documents" and your corpus (RAG Folder or RAG Corpus URL), adds the best passages to the system message, and returns them with the answer. off (default): no change.

input.name: RAG Folder
input.description: A folder of .txt, .md and .jsonl ({"id", "text"} per line) files to search, normally on the network volume. It is embedded once and the index is cached on the volume until a file changes. Ignored if missing, unless you set it yourself.

input.name: RAG Corpus URL
input.description: An http(s) URL of a .jsonl, .txt or .md file, or a .tar.gz/.tgz/.tar/.zip of them, downloaded and embedded when a worker starts (cached on the network volume if one is attached).

input.name: RAG Passages per Answer
input.description: How many passages go into each answer (1-32). A job can override it with "rag.top_k".

input.name: RAG Chunk Size
input.description: Characters per passage when documents are split (at least 100). Changing it rebuilds the corpus index.

input.name: RAG Chunk Overlap
input.description: Characters each passage repeats from the one before it (at most half the chunk size).

input.name: RAG Embedding Model
input.description: The embedding GGUF, as <owner>/<repo>/<file>.gguf on Hugging Face. It must be an embedding model Reflex supports (Nemotron-3.5-Embed).
